svg.title: تجمع الجوف الصحي | AlJouf Health Cluster
svg.desc: شعار بخلفية شفافة، مع الرمز المتجهي للصحة القابضة واسم تجمع الجوف الصحي بخط Janna LT المحوّل إلى مسارات.
svg.metadata: Cluster lockup reconstructed from the supplied July 2026 Health Holding identity manual and the publicly displayed official AlJouf reference. Original emblem vector geometry retained; raster fold-shadow patterns omitted for flat, completely vector artwork. Janna LT Bold and Regular wordmarks are outlined. No embedded images, external fonts, or scripts. Clear space: one quarter of emblem width.
